# P112 external evidence

P112 uses the official RCAEval RE1-SS archive as a separate-system development
source. The archive is downloaded from the pinned Zenodo URL, verified against
the source manifest, and ignored by Git. OpsCat does not redistribute it.

RE1-SS repetitions 1-3 are training, repetition 4 is validation, and repetition
5 is one-time confirmation. RE1-OB repetition 4 remains the P112 final blind
set and must not be scored before configuration freeze.
